newsitem.title: UK: BFI down nine in dull freight market.
newsitem.headline: BFI down nine in dull freight market.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index fell nine to 1450 points on Tuesday in what brokers said was generally featureless activity in the London dry cargo freight market.
The most significant reported fixture was the Andre re-let Royal Ocean for 54,000 Heavy Grains USGulf/Japan to Continental for 15-25 April at $24 no combo.
This was down 85 cents from Hanjin's fiuxture of NSAC tonnage for similar dates a week ago. The Baltic Handy Index was up two at 1104 in quiet conditions worldwide.
